unresolvedResearchScopes: 10 Year Old Cask Strength releases after17, market-specific ABV variants (including reported Batch002 at56.3% and Batch004 at58.6%), and older unnumbered bottlings. Standard verified batches1–17 are integrated; verify each variant separately before using its notes, photos or prices.
Cairdeas releases 2008 through 2018, including any age-stated or anniversary variants; verify each release, never synthesize missing years.
15 Year Old current relaunch versus older bottlings, 18 Year Old and discontinued core expressions such as Triple Wood.
Elements numbered releases, Friendship Cask single casks, Warehouse 1 exclusives and distillery exclusives.
25 Year Old Cask Strength annual editions and other rare ages, Ian Hunter books, Strong Characters chapters and historic official bottlings.
Independent bottlings with explicit Laphroaig attribution; establish producer or bottler evidence and cask identifiers. Secret Islay origin is insufficient.
